note: The drag ends when the pulled troop (or the Fisherman pulled to a building) is 0.2 tiles from him edge to edge: RoyaleAPI cr-api-data cards_stats_projectile FishermanProjectile drag_margin 200, drag_back_as_attractor true (drag_back_speed 850 and drag_self_speed 450 are the dragSpeed and selfDragSpeed above). Wiki Fisherman: he pulls enemy troops towards him, can counter a Hog Rider with a King Tower activation and activates the King's Tower against building chasers when placed in front of it (no numeric end point). Recording: Ian77 video G7cTO29IaQA game 1 (corpus battle 09YP9U9P90GQ), both Fisherman pulls of a Hog Rider read at 30 fps in 1080p (video 16.5 to 18 and 110.7 to 111.3): the Hog ends touching him, 1.2 to 1.6 tiles centre to centre (0.5 + 0.6 + 0.2 = 1.3), then takes the King Tower; the engine had stopped it at his 1.2 attack range (2.3 centre to centre). https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RoyaleAPI/cr-api-data/master/docs/json/cards_stats_projectile.json https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Fisherman
